Background shells started by a subagent no longer stay "Running" in the Background tasks panel after they exit.

- Claude Code delivers a background shell's completion notice to the loop that started it. When a subagent started the shell, the notice went into that subagent's turn and never reached desk-look, so the panel kept showing the task as running, with its timer still going, long after the command had exited
- desk-look now also reads the `[exited with code N]` line that Claude Code appends to a background shell's output file. Exit code 0 marks the task completed, and any other code marks it failed. The file is read again only when its size changes
- Tasks already stuck as running are corrected the next time the panel refreshes after `/reload-plugins`

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
